rationale: S-0055-01 proposes a project-wide DSGC measurement-protocol fix (replace FULL/E_ONLY/GABA_ONLY trio with FULL/EPSP_PASSIVE/IPSP_PASSIVE; save-and-zero gnabar_hh / gkbar_hh on soma + AIS for the passive-mode traces; drop per-synapse activation-time histogram; standardise trial length at 1400 ms). Per brainstorm 11 decision, this protocol fix is bundled into t0059 (bar_locked_gaba_ampa_sweep_t0057), which becomes the first task to ship the corrected trio. Future tasks will inherit the corrected protocol from t0059's library. Rejecting as covered by t0059.
